description:
Your job is extremely important, where you will be working directly with the CTO and Data Team Directors, and have the ability to advance your career.
 Vendors change metadata over 50 times a day. It’s your job to quickly assess, monitor and address issues to ensure data downloads are functioning properly.
 You will be doing a combination of data mapping and monitoring to rapidly fix issues working alongside the customer support and data monitoring teams to get things done.
 You will quickly learn how to map data based on a standard and automated processes.
 
 YOU MUST BE VERY SMART AND BE PASSIONATE ABOUT DATA.
 YOU MUST have graduated with a Bachelors Degree, preferably in Computer Science or related degrees and have experience working with data.
 You most likely just graduated from school or have 1-3 years of experience.
 Skills needed for the position:  Database bash scripting is required.
 Familiarity with relational databases like Oracle and MySQL. 
 Python experience is nice to have.
 
 You are the type of person that has a knack for solving problems quickly with little or no help.
 You are a team player, who likes to learn about new technologies.
 You have to know how to use excel and google sheets. 
 Flexibility to work a non-Monday-Friday schedule  (a Saturday instead of a Monday) is a plus.
 
 Process for Interviewing 
 Please submit your resume and LinkedIn profile by clicking “I’m Interested” and why you feel that you are a good fit for the position.
 Phone screen by Michael C. Bertoni, Chief Recruiting Officer
 Smarter Agent Online Assessment 
 Onsite Interview 
 Offer
 All the above can be completed expediently after completion of the online assessment.
